packages.label: צְדָקָה וְגַלְגַּלִּים
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the cosmic circulation of blessing: tzedaka IS the galgalim because both describe the same revolving, cyclical mechanism of divine providence — the phrase 'ki bigalal hadavar hazeh' (Shabbat 151b) equates tzedaka directly with the galal/circle that turns in the world. Nesher = rachamim = tzedaka (Zohar, Bava Batra): the eagle's upward soaring through the heavens IS the quality of compassion/tzedaka. Nehori de'a (Shmuel's 'the paths of the firmament are as clear to me as the streets of my city') = tzedaka-rachamim: the illuminated pathways of the sky are the same reality as compassionate giving. The cardinal directions east/west ARE the giver/receiver of tzedaka: east = the one who gives (zore'a = sows seeds of tzedaka going outward), west = the one who collects/the poor person (mekabetz = gathering inward, as 'umima'arav akabetzekha'). Galgalei harakia = mo'ed: the celestial spheres govern time and the appointed times (the verse 'darchei tzion avelot mibloi ba'ei mo'ed' equates mo'ed with the celestial spheres). All these are different faces of the same revolving, compassion-driven cosmic structure.

merge_notes.reason: Galgalei harakia = mo'ed: the celestial spheres ARE the appointed times because it is the spheres that govern and calculate the calendar. The verse 'darchei tzion avelot mibloi ba'ei mo'ed' — mo'ed is a bechina of the galgalei harakia, as the Rebbe states explicitly (source line 16). Since galgalim is already in CC8, this pair (galgalei harakia/mo'ed) shares the identical essential nature — they are the same domain of celestial-temporal structure — and merges into Package 1.

East = the giver of tzedaka; west = the collector of tzedaka (the poor person). Source line 11: 'mizrach, zeh bechina hanotein tzedaka... umarav, zeh hamekabetz hatzedaka.' The directional quality of east and west IS the tzedaka relationship — the outward-flowing giving energy (mizrach = zore'a latzedaka) and the inward-gathering receiving energy (marav = ukibatzekha). These two dyads are bechina of the tzedaka/galgalim domain: the galgal moves east to west and west to east, and tzedaka flows from giver (east) to receiver (west) and back. Merged into Package 1 as expressions of the same cosmic circulation.

packages.label: שַׁבָּת וֶאֱמוּנָה
packages.reason: Shabbat IS emunah because Shabbat testifies to two fundamental articles of faith: the renewal of the world (chidush ha'olam) and the unity of God (yichudo). These are not two separate things — Shabbat observance IS the act of emunah; they are the same essential reality expressed through time and action. The Torah (source line 8) states this with the bechina formula explicitly: 'veShabbat hi emunah, shema'amin bechidush ha'olam uveyichudo.' The emunah/Shabbat pair is the completion that tzedaka needs: without emunah (=Shabbat), the galgalim/tzedaka are missing their perfection. 'Shemesh beShabbat tzedaka la'aniyim' — the Sun of shabbat-emunah is what gives the galgalim their full illumination.

packages.label: בְּרִית וְשֶׁמֶשׁ
packages.reason: Shemesh (the sun) IS brit because the full radiance of the sun is only possible through the covenant: 'shemesh beShabbat tzedaka la'aniyim' — the sun shining fully is dependent on shmirat habrit, and conversely, a blemished brit means only the shadow/reflection of the sun appears (mareh chamah amukah min hatzel). Shaddai IS brit because God's name Shaddai is associated with 'she'amar le'olamo dai' and with 'shim na yadkha tachat yerechi' — Shaddai is the name of the brit-covenant that sustains the world. Source line 50: 'veshada lahu, zeh bechina brit, bechina Shaddai kanaal.' The three form a single cluster of the covenant's cosmic dimension: Shaddai (the divine name of covenant-sustaining) = brit (the covenant quality) = shemesh (the solar illumination that the covenant enables).

packages.label: פַּרְנָסָה וְלֶחֶם הַפָּנִים
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the Abraham-level of sustenance, where earthly food is elevated to the quality of the Showbread (lechem hapanim). Bira/bar umzon = the well in the wilderness = food that is outside holiness, 'behind the face' (vehistarti panai); once brought inside through proper service it becomes lechem hapanim. Mamon = bar umzon: money IS food/sustenance — both are the same reality of material provision. Se'uda = mamon: the meal IS money (both are the material sustenance domain, one abstract, one concrete). Chamah = 'kecham hayom' = 'lechem cham': the heat of Abraham's day (kecham hayom) IS the warm bread (lechem cham) which IS the Showbread — these three are the same concept seen through three different lenses (solar, temporal, gastronomic). Madregat Avraham = ba'al nefesh: the level of Abraham IS the ba'al nefesh — Abraham is the paradigm of the one who makes souls ('nefesh asher asu'), and his meals were always lechem hapanim in quality. Hithalekh = regalim (feet) = parnasa: the verse 'hithalekh lefanai' uses the root of walking/feet, and the Rebbe identifies this with 'regalim' = parnasa ('hayekum asher beragleihem — ze mamono shel adam sheama'amido al raglave'). The feet/walking of Abraham = his parnasa, which became parnasa on the level of the Showbread.

merge_notes.reason: These three form a single bechina chain (CC1): chamah ↔ kecham hayom ↔ lechem cham. The Rebbe identifies them explicitly in source lines 38-39: 'lechem cham beyom hilakcho — lechem hapanim, hem lechem cham, dargin de'Avraham, she'hu bechina kecham hayom. Umara'e chamah amukah min hatzel, chamah, bechina: kecham hayom, bechina lechem cham.' All three are expressions of Abraham's solar-level of warmth/illumination that manifests in his food. Merged into Package 4 because they are specifically about the parnasa/Abraham domain.

Madregat Avraham = ba'al nefesh: Abraham's level IS being a ba'al nefesh — a master of souls, one who makes nefashot. Source line 37: 'umi she'hu bemadregat Avraham, haynu bechina ba'al nefesh, azai beva'dai kol akhilotav use'udotav bechina lechem hapanim.' Their bechina relationship is direct: the Abraham-level = ba'al nefesh quality. Merged into Package 4 as specifying the type of person whose sustenance is naturally lechem hapanim.

Hithalekh = regalim (feet/walking) = parnasa. Source line 37: 'hithalekh, zeh bechina raglin, bechina parnasato, bechina: veet hayekum asher beragleihem (ve'dorshim raboteinu zachronam livrakha: ze mamono shel adam sheama'amido al raglave).' The hithalekh command to Abraham uses the root of feet/walking (raglin), and this IS bechina of his parnasa. Merged into Package 4 (parnasa domain) rather than Package 6 (spiritual/tzaddik domain) because this bechina explicitly grounds tefila's 'regel' quality in the material parnasa context of Abraham's walking before God.

packages.label: כִּסּוּפִין וּנְפָשׁוֹת
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the kisufin (holy yearning/longing) that creates nefashot (souls): the nekudot ARE nefesh because just as the soul is the life-force that animates the body, the vowel-points are the life-force that animates the letters — the same essential reality of 'animated form.' Ratzon = kisufin veha'hishtokekut: the will/desire IS the yearning — they are two names for the same interior striving. Ha'ala'at mayyin nukbin = kisufin: the mystical 'raising of feminine waters' is identical in nature to the yearning/longing — both describe the upward movement of desire toward the divine. Zahav = zivug: gold IS pairing/union, because 'mitzafon zahav ye'eteh' and the Zohar teaches 'it'aruta dizzivuga misitra dismala hu tzafon' — gold comes from the north which is the awakening of zivug; gold and zivug are the same essential energy. The three zivug-pairs (zivug hagufot via letters, zivugei haneshamot via nekudot, nezdavgu venitztarfu ha'otiyot = zivug hagufni) are all aspects of the same pairing-energy that originates in the kisufin. Teavutah dedkhar = mah shehadavar chozer veniksef elav (the object of male desire); teavutah denukba = mah shehe'niksef (the desiring subject's own longing) — these ARE the two poles of kisufin that generate two types of nefesh (male/female soul). All flow from the same root: yearning creates soul, soul creates union, union creates life.

merge_notes.reason: Nekudot = nefesh: the vowel-points ARE the soul of the letters. Source line 55: 'al ken hanekudot hem bechina nefesh, ki kemo shehanefesh hu chiut ha'adam... ken hanekudot hem hachiut vehanefesh shel ha'otiyot.' This is a pure bechina: two names for the same animating-life-force quality, one in the domain of language, one in the domain of persons. Merged into Package 5 as a core member of the kisufin-soul cluster.

Zahav = zivug: gold IS pairing/union. Source line 77: 'zahav hu bechina zivug, kemo shekatuv: mitzafon zahav ye'eteh, veit'aruta dizzivuga misitra dishmala shehu tzafon.' The north-direction, gold, and the awakening of zivug are the same essential energy. Merged into Package 5 as expressing the zivug-dimension that emerges from the kisufin.

Nezdavgu venitztarfu ha'otiyot = zivug hagufni: the pairing/combining of letters IS the bodily union. Source line 86: 've'al yedei hanekudot nezdavgu venitztarfu ha'otiyot, zeh bechina zivugei hagufot.' The combining of letters through nekudot IS the pairing of bodies. Merged into Package 5 as a sub-dimension of the kisufin-zivug chain.

Zivugam vehistarfutam shel hanekudot = zivugei haneshamot: the pairing of nekudot IS soul-unions. Source line 86: 'vezeh bechina zivugam vehistarfutam shel hanekudot, shehem bechina zivugei haneshamot.' Direct bechina statement. Merged into Package 5 as complementing the bodily-zivug pair — together they show the two levels of zivug (soul-level and body-level) that emerge from kisufin.

Mah shehadavar chozer veniksef elav = teavutah dedkhar (male desire/wanting): what the object returns and yearns back toward is the male soul-yearning. Source line 79: 'umah shehadavar chozer veniksef elav, hu bechina teavutah deddkhar, ve'aved nefesh dedar.' Direct bechina. Merged into Package 5 as one pole of the kisufin dyad.

Mah shehu niksef = teavutah denukba (female desire/wanting): the subject's own yearning IS the feminine soul-desire. Source line 79: 'ki mah shehu niksef hu bechina teavutah denukba, vehu aved nefesh nukba.' Direct bechina. Merged into Package 5 as the other pole of the kisufin dyad. Together CC23+CC24 express the dual-nature of yearning: the outgoing desire and the return-desire, which together produce a male soul and a female soul.

Ratzon = kisufin (CC13 already encodes this); ha'alat mayyin nukbin = kisufin. Source line 86: 'zeh bechina ha'alat mayyin nukbin kayadu'a.' The Zohar concept of ha'alat mayyin nukbin IS the kisufin — both describe the upward movement of feminine longing/arousal toward the divine. All three (ratzon, kisufin, ha'alat mayyin nukbin) are synonyms for the same essential reality. Merged into Package 5 as core kisufin-related nodes.

packages.label: לַמְדָן וְחָסִיד — הַצַּדִּיק וְהָרַב
packages.label_en: Scholar and Devout — the Tzaddik and the Rebbe
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the complete tzaddik/rav who must embody both Torah-scholarship (lamdan) and piety (chasid). Malakh = lamdan = Metatron (Mitat): the angel Metatron IS the lamdan quality because Metatron is the heavenly scribe who separates pure from impure, permitted from forbidden — exactly the function of the lamdan in halacha. Mitat = mishnah: Metatron IS Mishna because the Tikkunim equate the verse 'yehi rakia' (which is Metatron in the Tikkunim) with the Mishna that distinguishes between the upper and lower waters = between tahor and tameh, muttar and asur. Hashem Tzvaot = chasid: the divine name Tzvaot, interpreted as 'ot hu ba'tzava dileh' (it is a sign in its army), IS the chasid — the one who goes beyond the letter of the law in divine service. Ot hu betzava dilah = ot brit: the 'sign in its army' IS the sign of the covenant (the brit) — both describe the tzaddik's character as an embodied sign of divine presence. Tzaddik = ot brit = Rabbi Akiva: the tzaddik IS the covenant-sign, and Rabbi Akiva IS the tzaddik (he entered and departed in peace). Mi shenikhnas veniskarev latzaddik = tzaddik: the one who approaches the tzaddik properly and receives a straight path IS the bechina of tzaddik — he becomes a tzaddik by his proper approach. Arba'ah shenikhnesu laPardes = tzaddik verasha oved Elokim velo avado: the four who entered Pardes ARE the four types — this is the taxonomy frame that contains all four types. Tefila = regel: prayer IS the foot/regalim — prayer is called a bechina of regel because just as regel = regalim = the festivals where one appears before God, prayer is the daily standing-before-God that corresponds to the regel. This belongs in the spiritual-tzaddik package (not parnasa) because the context is the tzaddik's prayer that flows from his mouth ('torah yevakshu mipihu').

צדיק ורשע עובד אלקים ולא עבדו

merge_notes.reason: Malakh = lamdan = Mitat = Mishna — these four form a bechina chain (CC25). Source lines 22-23, 73: 'malakh, zeh bechina lamdan, bechina Mitat kanaal; tzvaot, ot hu batzava dileh, bechina: tzaddik ot brit.' And source line 73: 'mah shehu lamdan batorah, hu bechina malakh shehu Mitat... shehu bechina Mishna, hamavdil umafrish bein mayim dakin ubein mayim mesa'avim.' These four are the lamdan-dimension of the complete tzaddik: Torah-knowledge (mishna/halacha) = Metatron's separating function = angelic quality.

Chasid = Hashem Tzvaot: the pious/devout quality IS the Hashem Tzvaot dimension. Source line 73: 'vetzarich leidamot leqono lihyot chasid bema'asim tovim, vezeh bechina Hashem Tzvaot.' The chasid embodies the Hashem Tzvaot quality — serving God with love and going beyond the letter of the law. This is the complement to the lamdan/Mitat dimension.

merged_nodes: מי שהוא נכנס ונתקרב להצדיק והוא מקבל ממנו דרך ישרה לעבודת ה לפי מדרגתו וערכו
merge_notes.reason: These form CC2, already connected via bechina edges. Ot hu betzava dilah = ot brit (source line 23 and 70): 'tzvaot, ot hu batzava dileh, bechina: tzaddik ot brit.' The covenant-sign = the tzaddik. Tzaddik = Rabbi Akiva (he is the archetype of the tzaddik who enters and departs in peace). Mi shenikhnas... = tzaddik (source line 67): the one who properly approaches the tzaddik IS the tzaddik-type. All merged into Package 6 as facets of the tzaddik's spiritual identity.

merged_nodes: צדיק ורשע עובד אלקים ולא עבדו
merge_notes.reason: The four who entered Pardes = the four types (tzaddik, rasha, oved Elokim, lo avado). Source line 66: 'veeleh ha'arba bechinot hem bechinot tzaddik verasha oved Elokim velo avado.' This is a direct bechina — the Pardes story IS the four-type taxonomy. Merged into Package 6 as the structural frame for the tzaddik discussion. Note: the rasha (Aher) is present here as a type within the four-type taxonomy; Aher as an independent concept belongs in Package 8 (evil).

Tefila = regel: prayer IS a bechina of regel/foot. Source line 106 (final line of source text): 'hatefilah nikret bechina regel.' While 'regalim' in the parnasa context (Package 4) refers to feet = material sustenance (hithalekh = regalim = parnasa), the concept 'regel' here is explicitly named as the bechina of prayer itself — a distinct spiritual concept. Prayer's standing-before-God corresponds structurally to the regel-festivals as standing-before-God. Merged into Package 6 (spiritual/tzaddik domain) because the source context is the tzaddik's mouth bringing out kisufin through prayer ('torah yevakshu mipihu... ve'et shav'atam yishma veyoshi'em').

packages.label: הֵצִיץ וָמֵת וְנִפְגַּע
packages.label_en: Gazed and Died, or Gazed and Was Harmed
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the sincere but imperfect encounter with the tzaddik's light — the person who approaches the tzaddik with a true heart but receives more light than their level can bear. This is a good polarity: the Rebbe explicitly states (source line 68) 'afillu heititz vamet heititz venifga, shnehem hem bechina tzaddik, va'aleihem gam ken ne'emar: tzaddikim yelkhu vam.' They are tzaddikim — their error is one of level, not of intent. Oved Elokim = heititz vamet: the 'server of God' type who encounters the rav's light and his heart blazes so intensely that he can die from it — this is bechina oved Elokim (a genuine divine-server but beyond his level). Lo avado = heititz venifga: the one who 'did not serve' (lo avado) = the one who goes out of his mind because he rises above his level — this is bechina heititz venifga. Mi sheyotze mida'ato = heititz venifga: one who loses his mind from rising above his level IS the heititz venifga — same essential reality.

merged_nodes: שנתלהב לבו מאד ועל ידי זה יוכל למות
merge_notes.reason: These three form CC14. Oved Elokim = heititz vamet: the oved Elokim type IS the one who gazes and dies. Source line 68: 'veyesh mi shehu bechina heititz vamet... bezeh bechina oved Elokim.' Shenitlahav libo = heititz vamet: the one whose heart blazes from the rav's light = heititz vamet. Same essential reality — the overwhelming encounter with light beyond one's level that can cause death. Merged together as the first sub-cluster of the imperfect encounter.

merged_nodes: מי שיוצא מדעתו מחמת שעולה למעלה ממדרגתו
merge_notes.reason: These form CC15. Lo avado = heititz venifga: source line 68: 'veyesh mi sheyotze mida'ato mechamat she'oleh lema'alah mimadregato, vehu bechina heititz venifga, bechina lo avado.' The one who goes out of his mind from rising above his level IS heititz venifga IS lo avado (the one who 'did not serve' = Ben Azzai). Same essential nature: spiritual overwhelm causing mental disruption. Merged as the second sub-cluster. Both CC14 and CC15 are merged into Package 7 because they share the essential nature of the good-but-overwhelmed spiritual encounter (polarity: good), as distinct from Package 8 (Aher, who is evil/rasha).

packages.label: אַחֵר וּמְקַצֵּץ בִּנְטִיעוֹת
packages.label_en: Aher and the One Who Cuts the Shoots
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the rasha who approaches the tzaddik with evil intent and uses the encounter to sin more deeply. Aher = mi sheto'eh vesover shebechinot lamdan levad hu ha'ikar: Aher IS the one who erroneously believes that Torah-scholarship alone is the essence — Aher saw Metatron (the lamdan-angel) and concluded it had independent authority, exactly the error of believing Torah without chasidut/piety is sufficient (source line 74: 'umi sheto'eh vesover... she'lamdan levad hu ha'ikar, hu bechina Aher shekiletz benitiyot'). Aher = mi shemitkarev latzaddik umekaletz benitiyot vekofer bakol: Aher IS the one who approaches the tzaddik and cuts the shoots and denies everything — this is the rasha type (source line 69). Both describe the same essential reality: the person who comes to the tzaddik with evil in his heart (tina hayeta belibo) and inevitably finds a way to sin through the encounter.
